Ajinkya Rahane Retires From All Forms of International Cricket

Indian cricketer Ajinkya Rahane announced his retirement from all formats of international cricket on June 4, 2024. The 38-year-old's final international appearance was in July 2023 against the West Indies. Rahane, who represented India in 85 Test matches, 29 One Day Internationals, and 2 Twenty20 Internationals, will now pursue opportunities in the Indian Premier League and potentially other leagues. His career included captaining India in Test matches.
